scenes.say: It's [1 a.m.|one a.m.] Your body is exhausted. And your brain... just called a *meeting*.
That email. Something you said in [2014.|twenty fourteen.] Tomorrow. Then... the email *again*.
Psychologists call this *repetitive negative thinking*. It keeps the mind on alert.
By day, the world keeps you busy. In the dark, unfinished business finally gets the floor.
Across dozens of studies, more of it goes with *worse sleep*.
But fighting it can *backfire*. People told not to think of a white bear... thought about it *more* afterward.
What helps? Five minutes writing tomorrow's *to-do list*. People who did it fell asleep about [9 minutes|nine minutes] faster than people listing finished tasks.
If it keeps you up most nights for weeks, talk to a doctor.
Your brain isn't broken. It just doesn't want to forget. So write it down... and let it *rest*.
